lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11-12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso. Spacing is approximately uniform in the central torso but increases in the anterior and posterior sections.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 10th line from the anterior, located in the lower third of the torso height near the hind limb junction.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Short, abbreviated line segments are visible on the posterior flank that do not reach the dorsal ridge; the 11th and 12th lines terminate as dashed segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5-7 high-contrast white spots is located on the lower haunch and upper thigh area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-thigh align horizontally, creating a semi-connected geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: White facial markings include a chevron-like spot between the eyes and white patches on the lower limbs and chest.
